parameters.query:
-- Select the newest pending Date edit for each Session, not the oldest
-- delivered notification. Process one Session per execution.
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT e.id, e.event_key, e.origin, e.entity_type,
           e.external_id, e.notion_page_id, e.changed_at,
           e.changed_fields, e.status
    FROM sync_events e
    WHERE e.status = 'RECEIVED'
      AND e.entity_type = 'Session'
      AND e.external_id ~ '^BR-S-[0-9]{6}$'
      AND (
          (e.origin = 'Notion' AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
              WHERE f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
                AND f->>'action' = 'SYNC_CANDIDATE'
          )) OR
          (e.origin = 'Google' AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
              WHERE f->>'field' = 'Date'
                AND f->>'newValue' IS NOT NULL
          ))
      )
), resolved AS (
    SELECT c.*, COALESCE(c.notion_page_id, (
        SELECT MIN(h.notion_page_id)
        FROM sync_events h
        WHERE h.entity_type = 'Session'
          AND h.external_id = c.external_id
          AND h.notion_page_id IS NOT NULL
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.notion_page_id) = 1
    )) AS resolved_notion_page_id
    FROM candidates c
), ranked AS (
    SELECT r.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY r.external_id
             ORDER BY r.changed_at DESC, r.id DESC
           ) AS date_edit_rank
    FROM resolved r
    WHERE r.resolved_notion_page_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT id, event_key, origin, entity_type, external_id,
       resolved_notion_page_id AS notion_page_id,
       changed_at, changed_fields, status
FROM ranked
WHERE date_edit_rank = 1
ORDER BY changed_at ASC, id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    e.id,
    e.event_key,
    e.origin,
    e.external_id,
    e.changed_at,
    e.changed_fields,
    e.status,
    e.event_payload
FROM sync_events e
WHERE e.entity_type = 'Session'
  AND e.external_id = $1
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) AS f
          WHERE f->>'field' = 'Date'
             OR f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
      )
  )
ORDER BY e.changed_at DESC, e.id DESC;

INSERT INTO sync_operations (
    event_id,
    entity_type,
    external_id,
    field_name,
    target_system,
    attempted_value,
    status
)
SELECT
    e.id,
    'Session',
    e.external_id,
    'Date',
    CASE
        WHEN e.origin = 'Notion' THEN 'Google'
        WHEN e.origin = 'Google' THEN 'Notion'
    END,
    to_jsonb($3::text),
    'PENDING'
FROM sync_events e
WHERE e.id = $1::bigint
  AND e.external_id = $2
  AND e.entity_type = 'Session'
  AND e.status = 'RECEIVED'
  AND $4::boolean = true
  AND $5 IN ('NOTION_TO_GOOGLE', 'GOOGLE_TO_NOTION')
  AND $6 = 'DEV_ELIGIBLE_SESSION_DATE'
  AND (
      (e.origin = 'Notion'
       AND $5 = 'NOTION_TO_GOOGLE'
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
           WHERE f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
             AND f->>'action' = 'SYNC_CANDIDATE'
       ))
      OR
      (e.origin = 'Google'
       AND $5 = 'GOOGLE_TO_NOTION'
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
           WHERE f->>'field' = 'Date'
             AND f->>'newValue' = $3
       ))
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sync_operations op
      WHERE op.event_id = e.id
        AND op.field_name = 'Date'
  )
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    external_id,
    field_name,
    target_system,
    attempted_value,
    status;

WITH completed_operation AS (
    UPDATE sync_operations
    SET
        status = 'SUCCESS',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        error_message = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::bigint
      AND event_id = $2::bigint
      AND entity_type = 'Session'
      AND external_id = $3
      AND field_name = 'Date'
      AND target_system = 'Notion'
      AND attempted_value = to_jsonb($4::text)
      AND status = 'PENDING'
      AND $5 = $6
      AND $7 = $4
    RETURNING *
),
saved_state AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_field_state (
        entity_type,
        external_id,
        field_name,
        last_synced_value,
        last_synced_at,
        last_event_key
    )
    SELECT
        op.entity_type,
        op.external_id,
        op.field_name,
        op.attempted_value,
        NOW(),
        e.event_key
    FROM completed_operation op
    JOIN sync_events e ON e.id = op.event_id
    WHERE e.origin = 'Google'
      AND e.status = 'RECEIVED'
    ON CONFLICT (entity_type, external_id, field_name)
    DO UPDATE SET
        last_synced_value = EXCLUDED.last_synced_value,
        last_synced_at = EXCLUDED.last_synced_at,
        last_event_key = EXCLUDED.last_event_key
    RETURNING *
),
closed_event AS (
    UPDATE sync_events
    SET
        status = 'APPLIED',
        processed_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $2::bigint
      AND entity_type = 'Session'
      AND external_id = $3
      AND status = 'RECEIVED'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_state)
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_operation)
        AS operations_completed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_state)
        AS field_states_saved,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM closed_event)
        AS events_closed;

parameters.query:
WITH completed_operation AS (
    UPDATE sync_operations
    SET
        status = 'SUCCESS',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        error_message = NULL
    WHERE id = $1::bigint
      AND event_id = $2::bigint
      AND entity_type = 'Session'
      AND external_id = $3
      AND field_name = 'Date'
      AND target_system = 'Google'
      AND attempted_value = to_jsonb($4::text)
      AND status = 'PENDING'
      AND $5 = $3
      AND $6 = $4
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM sync_events e
          WHERE e.id = $2::bigint
            AND e.origin = 'Notion'
            AND e.status = 'RECEIVED'
            AND e.external_id = $3
      )
    RETURNING *
),
saved_state AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_field_state (
        entity_type,
        external_id,
        field_name,
        last_synced_value,
        last_synced_at,
        last_event_key
    )
    SELECT
        op.entity_type,
        op.external_id,
        op.field_name,
        op.attempted_value,
        NOW(),
        e.event_key
    FROM completed_operation op
    JOIN sync_events e ON e.id = op.event_id
    ON CONFLICT (entity_type, external_id, field_name)
    DO UPDATE SET
        last_synced_value = EXCLUDED.last_synced_value,
        last_synced_at = EXCLUDED.last_synced_at,
        last_event_key = EXCLUDED.last_event_key
    RETURNING *
),
closed_event AS (
    UPDATE sync_events
    SET
        status = 'APPLIED',
        processed_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $2::bigint
      AND entity_type = 'Session'
      AND external_id = $3
      AND status = 'RECEIVED'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_state)
    RETURNING id
),
-- Only after a verified successful Notion -> Google write, retire
-- older Notion notifications of that same Session Date field.
superseded_events AS (
    UPDATE sync_events stale
    SET status = 'IGNORED', processed_at = NOW()
    WHERE stale.entity_type = 'Session'
      AND stale.external_id = $3
      AND stale.origin = 'Notion'
      AND stale.status = 'RECEIVED'
      AND stale.id <> $2::bigint
      AND stale.changed_at < (
          SELECT current_event.changed_at
          FROM sync_events current_event
          WHERE current_event.id = $2::bigint
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(stale.changed_fields) f
          WHERE f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
            AND f->>'action' = 'SYNC_CANDIDATE'
      )
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM closed_event)
    RETURNING stale.id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_operation)
        AS operations_completed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_state)
        AS field_states_saved,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM closed_event)
        AS events_closed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superseded_events)
        AS older_notion_date_events_ignored;

nodes.name: DEV — Complete Google Session Date Operation

parameters.query:
WITH ledger AS (

    -- All captured events
    SELECT
        'EVENT' AS record_type,
        e.id AS record_id,
        e.entity_type,
        e.external_id,
        e.origin AS source,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT string_agg(
                COALESCE(
                    f->>'field',
                    f->>'propertyName',
                    '?'
                ) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN f ? 'newValue'
                    THEN ' → ' || (f->>'newValue')
                    ELSE ''
                END,
                ', '
            )
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
        ), '') AS detail,
        e.status,
        e.changed_at AS activity_at,
        e.processed_at AS completed_at
    FROM sync_events e

    UNION ALL

    -- Synchronization write operations
    SELECT
        'OPERATION',
        o.id,
        o.entity_type,
        o.external_id,
        e.origin || ' → ' || o.target_system,
        o.field_name || ' → ' ||
            COALESCE(o.attempted_value #>> '{}', '?'),
        o.status,
        o.attempted_at,
        o.completed_at
    FROM sync_operations o
    LEFT JOIN sync_events e ON e.id = o.event_id

    UNION ALL

    -- Latest successful shared field values
    SELECT
        'FIELD STATE',
        NULL::bigint,
        s.entity_type,
        s.external_id,
        'Google ↔ Notion',
        s.field_name || ' = ' ||
            COALESCE(s.last_synced_value #>> '{}', '?'),
        'SYNCED',
        s.last_synced_at,
        s.last_synced_at
    FROM sync_field_state s
)

SELECT
    record_type,
    record_id,
    entity_type,
    external_id,
    source,
    detail,
    status,
    activity_at,
    completed_at
FROM ledger
ORDER BY
    activity_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    record_type,
    record_id DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH correlated_echo AS (
    SELECT e.id
    FROM sync_events e
    JOIN sync_operations op
      ON op.entity_type = e.entity_type
     AND op.external_id = e.external_id
     AND op.field_name = 'Date'
     AND op.target_system = 'Notion'
     AND op.status = 'SUCCESS'
     AND op.attempted_value = to_jsonb($3::text)
    JOIN sync_events original ON original.id = op.event_id
    JOIN sync_field_state state
      ON state.entity_type = e.entity_type
     AND state.external_id = e.external_id
     AND state.field_name = 'Date'
     AND state.last_synced_value = to_jsonb($3::text)
    WHERE e.id = $1::bigint
      AND e.entity_type = 'Session'
      AND e.external_id = $2
      AND e.origin = 'Notion'
      AND e.status = 'RECEIVED'
      AND original.origin = 'Google'
      AND $3 = $4 AND $4 = $5
      AND e.changed_at BETWEEN op.attempted_at AND op.completed_at
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
          WHERE f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
            AND f->>'action' = 'SYNC_CANDIDATE'
      )
)
UPDATE sync_events e
SET status = 'IGNORED', processed_at = NOW()
FROM correlated_echo c
WHERE e.id = c.id
RETURNING e.id, e.external_id, e.status, e.processed_at;
